text: 2-day-old male infant. The infant was born via a home birth without complications. The mother reports that the infant has had bilious vomiting and has not been able to pass meconium since birth. She also notes that the infant's abdomen appears distended.

speaker: Doctor

The clinical picture of a 2-day-old with bilious vomiting and failure to pass meconium strongly suggests a lower intestinal obstruction, most likely Hirschsprung's disease. To confirm this, I need to see the results of an abdominal X-ray and consider a contrast enema.
